description:
I'm a second-year Information Science and Engineering undergraduate at Bangalore Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with a strong interest in AI/ML, data science, computer vision, and building technology that solves real-world problems.

I enjoy working across the development process, from exploring datasets and developing machine learning models to building APIs and creating usable web applications. My technical experience includes Python, C/C++, JavaScript, React, FastAPI, TensorFlow, etc.
